text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 30, 2019) for 201 Cedric Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated April 30, 2019, regarding the property located at 201 Cedric Avenue, Folder No. 19 146690 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to August 22, 2019, with a request that all entrances and exits be cleared and dealt as a priority.
